description:
pattern     stepped-rail / process
surface     dark
kit         none
form        Columns 1–4 provide the narrative context on leadership maturity, while columns 5–12 display a 5-step horizontal progression track with connecting cyan telemetry lines, documentary photo nodes, and role reflection descriptions. On mobile, the rail transitions into a vertical step-by-step numbered pathway.
copy
  eyebrow      GROWTH IN RESPONSIBILITY
  heading      Leadership Progression
  intro        True leadership is earned in increments — starting from active listening to ultimately steering multi-disciplinary teams toward unified goals.
  step-1-title Member
  step-1-desc  Joined university tech societies with an open mind, eager to absorb best practices and contribute to grassroots initiatives.
  step-2-title Volunteer
  step-2-desc  Stepped forward to manage logistical operations, event coordination, and participant support for faculty gatherings.
  step-3-title Organizer
  step-3-desc  Spearheaded university-wide technical workshops, coordinating guest speakers, schedules, and lab infrastructure.
  step-4-title Project Lead
  step-4-desc  Directed software development teams through full sprint cycles, managing repositories, code reviews, and project milestones.
  step-5-title Leader
  step-5-desc  Served as a mentor and executive society officer, establishing strategic vision, community partnerships, and legacy handovers.
image       4:3; set of 5 candid leadership photographs showing freshman registration, event registration desk, stage organizing, team code review table, and podium address; placed inside each step card, treatment documentary; alt: Leadership evolution steps of Tharindu Perera from member to leader
motion      Horizontal track scrolls smoothly with parallax offset; step nodes trigger pulse animation and fade-in sequentially at 90ms intervals.
plan check  heading placed; 5-step progression (Member, Volunteer, Organizer, Project Lead, Leader) each with a short description and a photo placed.
layout_description: Two-column split with left title column and right horizontal step track with continuous progression line.
